title: FB-038 make finalize release rollback on generator failure
summary: Fix FR-051 by making release finalization recover packet and metadata state if a post-move generator fails.
reason: Worker finding W11-004 showed finalize_release moves packets and updates version metadata before generator scripts complete, leaving partial release state when a generator fails.
behavior_before: Generator failure after packet movement could leave packets under released/, remove unreleased packet files, and update VERSION/manifest state partially.
behavior_after: Generator failure rolls moved packets and metadata outputs back to their pre-finalization state before re-raising the failure.

rollback_plan: Restore the prior finalize_release implementation and remove the rollback regression test.
